description: Run one inference paid PER CALL in Bitcoin BSV via x402, no prepaid channel. Non-custodial, two steps: (1) call without payment to get the 402 quote (status payment_required, accepts[]); nothing is spent. (2) Build and sign a BSV payment for that quote in your own wallet (for example fetchWithX402 / buildPayment in @bsvkey/x402-bsv-client) and call again with the same prompt, model, maxTokens and webSearch plus payment = the base64 X-PAYMENT value. Returns the completion plus the on-chain settlement txid. This server never takes a private key: a wif argument is refused. On failure returns isError "error: <code> (<status>): <message>". Codes: key_refused (a private key was sent; it was not used or forwarded); payment_failed (402: the payment did not settle; nothing is spent); invalid_request (400: unknown model or bad input; nothing is spent); upstream_failed (502: the payment SETTLED but the model provider then failed; the text includes the settlement txid. There is no automatic refund: contact embryospace@gmail.com with that txid).

model.description: Model id or policy: auto|cheapest|best, claude-*, grok-*.

payment.description: The base64 X-PAYMENT header value your wallet signed for the quote from step 1. Omit to get the quote.

webSearch.description: Let the model search the live web (adds a per-search fee to the quote).

name: x402_infer
